scenarios.prompt: A camera-relative character accelerates, brakes, crosses a slope and leaves a ledge. Define logical movement state while delegating jump forgiveness to jump-leniency.

criteria.ownership: Owns movement integration/grounding while jump-leniency owns coyote/buffer and platform-jump owns arc tuning.
criteria.clock: Logical position/velocity/ground transitions are independent of render interpolation rate.
criteria.evidence: Input-trace replay covers acceleration, slope/stairs, ledge departure and root-motion collision where applicable.
